preparation_notes.focus: Check whether all-source-boundaries-clear claims address page 5's 90% batch-delivery threshold and page 9's asserted supply/reliability-to-clinical linkage; narrow method notes on other pages do not automatically apply globally.
Separate explicitly marked public benchmarks and future targets from unsupported assertions of completed internal team measurements; preserve cross-object comparison restrictions.

Check unsupported funding-qualification claim and per-person to per-household annual income conversion; page 5 shows 120 households multiplied by 2.16万元/household-year without visible one-participant-per-household assumption.

Distinguish correct arithmetic from unsupported claims that alternatives cannot repay; check whether a quantified 18-month conservative calculation is actually supplied and avoid charging the same anchor twice.

Distinguish explicitly disclosed engineering assumptions from proven diagnosis. The phrase high by 29% relative to normal has a different denominator from treating 29% of the current hydraulic total as recoverable loss; approximate 18.2-to-18 months itself is valid rounding.

Check causal claims against supplied figures; distinguish incremental R&D/revenue ratio from total R&D share; inspect cash-runway duration versus the elapsed period of a crisis. Do not automatically treat every rhetorical juxtaposition as proof of causation.

limits: All 14 final reports were inspected within a targeted scope; not all 130 pages were visually re-inspected and not every criterion was independently rescored.
Agreement between two isolated model calls is not proof of correctness; reported findings include shared misses.
Supported binary answers can still contain wrong page references, numerical descriptions, overlap objects or visibility claims.

Actual overlap, readability severity, chart interpretation and common-knowledge exceptions must not be collapsed into one error label. The 10/B timing-origin concern is retained as an interpretation gap rather than a high-confidence extra reversed verdict.
Findings do not create new human truth, measure general accuracy, justify a winner, or alter frozen results.

completion_meaning: Completed the declared targeted QA of all 14 frozen final reports; not an exhaustive independent rescoring.
